name: mha_with_lse_d128_causal
description: Causal multi-head attention forward returning O and LSE, bf16 inputs. Q/K/V share shape (B,H,S,D). Outputs: O = softmax(Q@K^T/sqrt(D))@V (bf16, [B,H,S,D]) and LSE = max(P) + log(sum(exp(P - max(P)))) where P = Q@K^T/sqrt(D) (fp32 natural-log, [B,H,S]), with a lower-triangular mask over (query_pos, key_pos). Reference is torch.ops.aten._scaled_dot_product_cudnn_attention; LSE is squeezed from (B,H,S,1) to (B,H,S).

S.description: sequence length (Q and KV share this axis)

reference:
import torch


def run(Q, K, V):
    out = torch.ops.aten._scaled_dot_product_cudnn_attention(
        Q, K, V,
        None,    # attn_bias
        True,    # compute_log_sumexp
        0.0,     # dropout_p
        True,    # is_causal
        False,   # return_debug_mask
    )
    return out[0], out[1].squeeze(-1)
